page_title: SHU 0-3 TOT | Sheffield Utd v Tottenham Hotspur 19/05/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+3' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Jack Robinson (Sheffield Utd) was quite harsh and Andy Madley didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Mikey Moore (Tottenham) was too forceful with his tackle and Andy Madley interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
88' Ange Postecoglou has decided to make a change. Mikey Moore (Tottenham) replaces James Maddison.
88' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Heung-Min Son departs the field of play to be replaced by Dane Scarlett (Tottenham).
87' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
82' Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the right post.

80' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
80' James Maddison (Tottenham) looks like he will be the one to take the corner kick.
78' The attendance is 29116.
76' Substitution. Oliver Skipp has come on for Rodrigo Bentancur (Tottenham).
76' Ange Postecoglou has decided to substitute Pedro Porro (Tottenham) and he is replaced by Emerson Royal.
74' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 5:13.
70' Chris Wilder has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Daniel Jebbison (Sheffield Utd) replacing Ben Brereton Diaz.
69' Today's match ends for Max Lowe who will be replaced by Mason Holgate (Sheffield Utd).
66' Here is a change. Pape Matar Sarr is going off and Ange Postecoglou gives the last tactical orders to Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg (Tottenham).

65' 0 - 3 Goal! James Maddison plays in Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham), who shows great determination to get to the ball before a couple of defenders and from inside the box slots it into the bottom right corner 0:3.
64' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) has a great chance inside the six-yard box, shoots low to the middle of the goal, but Wesley Foderingham pulls off an exquisite save to deny him.
62' The substitution is prepared. Rhian Brewster (Sheffield Utd) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Cameron Archer.
62' Chris Wilder prepares a substitution. Ollie Arblaster is replaced by Andre Brooks (Sheffield Utd).
59' 0 - 2 Pedro Porro (Tottenham) with a wonderful piece of finishing. He makes a yard for himself after a well-taken pass inside the box and nets under the crossbar.
59' James Maddison (Tottenham) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds James Maddison (Tottenham) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
59' The ball is whipped in from the corner by James Maddison (Tottenham), but one of the defenders gets it clear.

58' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat. Now Tottenham have a corner.
56' Jayden Bogle (Sheffield Utd) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Andy Madley blows for a foul.
54' Sheffield Utd are ruled offside.
54' James Maddison (Tottenham) overhits the corner kick and none of his teammates can their head on it. The ball goes out of play and Sheffield Utd will have a goal kick.
54' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The referee points to the corner flag and Tottenham will take a corner.
53' Pape Matar Sarr (Tottenham) tries to create a chance, but puts too much weight on his pass.
52' The ball is cleared after Brennan Johnson (Tottenham) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
51' Andy Madley blows for a foul after Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
49' Great save! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the bottom right corner was brilliantly saved by Guglielmo Vicario.
48' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Andy Madley blows his whistle and the second half starts.
45+5' The match has reached half-time.
45+3' Dangerous play by Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham). Andy Madley blows his whistle for a foul.
45+1' James Maddison (Tottenham) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
45+1' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Tottenham.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
43' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Andy Madley no option but to blow his whistle.
41' The referee blows his whistle as Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) was too aggressive in his challenge.
37' Andy Madley shows a yellow card to Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) for his blatant foul.
37' Sheffield Utd failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

37' The defence had a hard time blocking out the strike from Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd). He didn't hesitate and finished from outside the box right after he had received a pass from his teammate. Sheffield Utd have been awarded a corner kick.
35' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Sheffield Utd comes to nothing.

34' What a miss! Cameron Archer (Sheffield Utd) is left standing right in front of goal with only the keeper to beat after a clever pass, but he somehow contrives to toe poke the ball just past the right post.
34' James Maddison (Tottenham) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.

33' Pedro Porro (Tottenham) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the bottom left corner. Wesley Foderingham is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The referee signals a corner kick to Tottenham.
32' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sheffield Utd.
30' Cristian Gabriel Romero (Tottenham) misses a great chance! He latches on to a fine cross into the box, but his effort misses the right post by a whisker.

30' Well-positioned Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the left post, but Wesley Foderingham reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
29' James Maddison (Tottenham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.
28' Heung-Min Son (Tottenham) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
26' Ollie Arblaster (Sheffield Utd) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
25' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.

22' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) gets on the end of a defence splitting pass inside the box and immediately directs a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the Wesley Foderingham makes a great save.
21' Max Lowe (Sheffield Utd) makes a strong challenge and Andy Madley blows for a foul.
17' Here's the current ball possession statistics for both teams – 46:54.

12' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
11' Ben Brereton Diaz (Sheffield Utd) latches onto a cross inside the box and aims a shot towards the right side of the goal, but Guglielmo Vicario reacts superbly to deny him.
10' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
8' Gustavo Hamer (Sheffield Utd) takes the free kick but it's straight at the goalkeeper.
7' Dejan Kulusevski (Tottenham) commits a rough challenge and Andy Madley blows his whistle for an infringement. Sheffield Utd will take a free kick near the side line.
5' Chris Wilder is forced to make a change. Ben Osborn is unable to continue due to injury, Vini Souza (Sheffield Utd) comes on.
4' The game is interrupted now, Ben Osborn (Sheffield Utd) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
4' Micky van de Ven (Tottenham) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Andy Madley has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
